testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-024: Page heading reads exactly Place Your Order

scenario.summary: As a created Sales Rep (Shop As) with an item in the cart, the combined page heading reads exactly 'Place Your Order' (capital Y and O, no '!'). Known failure until BMP-500 is fixed: qa shows 'Place your order!'.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
In Web Admin open Users, find the created Sales Rep by its user name (@user.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown
Enter 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 and click Add to Cart
Open the Cart and Checkout page from the Header
Read the page heading and compare it exactly with 'Place Your Order'
stateChanges: The Sales Rep user and its allotment are created for the test by their collections and deleted at teardown
Cart line added by Add to Cart
assertions: The page heading equals exactly 'Place Your Order' (not 'Place your order!')
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-024 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it
User decision 2026-11-26 (analysis section 8, Q4): assert exactly 'Place Your Order'; the test fails until BMP-500 is fixed (known failure linked to BMP-500)
Precondition 'heading store attribute at its default value' is not checkable: the attribute does not exist yet (BMP-500); expected text from the FSD default

qa finding (2026-11-27): the Header Cart opens a cart drawer; its Checkout link opens the combined page. Defect against SAN-011 (user, 2026-11-27; config/known-failures.yaml): the Header Cart should open the combined page directly. T2 soft-checks the direct open (fails on qa) and then goes on through the drawer, as the other tests do
